plugin.name: The Saboteur Fusion Fix
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or a borderless window that covers the monitor. Resolution and window mode apply after restarting.
FPSLimit.description: Limit the frame rate. 0 removes the limit; -1 follows the current monitor refresh rate. Clock, driving and mouse timing corrections remain active at every limit.
ConsoleGamma.description: Use the gamma of the Xbox 360 version.
AntiAliasing.description: SMAA anti-aliasing, applied before the HUD is drawn.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Resets this page to its defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.FOVFactor.help: Changes the camera width. 1.0 keeps the original framing.
menu.FixHUD.help: Corrects HUD proportions and placement. Restart the game to apply.
menu.SkipIntro.help: Skips startup logos. Story movies still play. Restart the game to apply.
textlanguage.description: Language of the fix's own texts. Auto follows the game's language.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the game window while the game is active. It is released when the game loses the focus, while the window is moved and at once when this is turned off.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game and its sound while its window isn't active. Off keeps it running in the background.
checkupdates.description: Checks for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Settings; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if it is installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for The Saboteur Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for The Saboteur Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Appearance of native controller button prompts. Auto keeps the game's Xbox artwork. Changes apply after restarting.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies to the next camera update.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Limit HUD width to an aspect ratio. Auto follows the display.
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup logos and title trailer. Story movies and loading initialization are preserved. Applies after restarting.
CutsceneBorders.description: Keep the original 16:9 cinematic framing with borders. Letterbox retains the original animated artwork above and below; Pillarbox adds side borders on wider screens; Both enables both. Off fills the screen horizontally (Hor+). Gameplay and videos are independent.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Play the original letterbox entrance and exit animations. Turn off for immediate borders. This changes only scenes that request the original letterbox.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original fits the whole video within a 4:3 area. Fill fits the whole video within the screen. Neither crops or stretches the picture.
